environment.location: gothic void-world terrace, flagstones, iron rail
environment.light_behavior: glow flickers; lightning overexposes for single beats

elements.description: woman, identity carried by reference images
elements.environment_interaction: loose hair strands lift in the wind
elements.action: taps the table as she speaks a teasing line, then stills, mouth closed

elements.description: giant bald warrior, black-and-gold armor, ref-carried
elements.environment_interaction: armored pauldron catches lightning glints in near foreground
elements.action: listens motionless, seen from behind, out of focus

elements.description: porcelain teapot and cups, glaze reflecting lightning
elements.environment_interaction: tea trembles at her table-tap; steam tears sideways in the wind
fabric shivers in the storm wind

elements.description: massive chitinous bulk in the distant ruins
elements.action: drags past slowly, ignoring the patio, exits behind a spire
